svg.text: Drawn, not computed. Every line here is lib/hand.ts, the generator the app runs — pressed, not ruled.
Four gestures a hand makes in a notebook, and one edge. Same seed, same line — a border never redraws on a re-render.
a panel, each side run a little past its corner
Serif names things. Mono is the system speaking. The hand is the gardener in the margin. Sans reads.
INSTRUMENT SERIF · TITLES, 庭 目録
Everything you know you know, drawn as one garden.
walked one stone › the next › the one after
The first breath of a note: its first sentence,
cut at a hundred and twenty characters.
What the garden is made of, sketched. Everything here is in the app today.
The filters. Everything is on by default, so
the gesture is for what is off: struck through,
What the note says first, before it is opened:
a sentence and a half of it, then the rest
The card that follows the pointer over a stone: what it is, before it is opened.
Rings are for these, strikes for not these.
Beds are opt-in here, so the chosen ones are ringed in their own colour.
THE WHOLE · ONE MARK PER NOTE, SET DOWN BY HAND
Discs drawn on paper: inked round with a pen that presses unevenly, hatched away from the light. Labels lettered by hand. Both themes.
sumi — ink reversed, the rim lit
Colour is lib/palette.ts and nowhere else. The pen is the ink let down to 90%; the paper has tooth at 6%.
The Center's identity is 'drawn, not computed' — brush-pen ribbon strokes, hand stipple. Niwa is its sibling: the same hand, a finer pen, on a dry garden.
Hold ⇧ and draw a ring round stones to gather them; the ring you draw is inked the same way. Every stone opened is a step on a pencil trail; [ walks back.
